entry.name: array.random
entry.digest: Generate a random array of a specified length
entry.description: Creates a new array object of a specified length, pre-filled with random numbers.

arguments.name: length
arguments.description: The length of the generated array.

arguments.name: initial-range
arguments.description: The range of random values to generate. If both values are integers, random integers will be generated, otherwise random floating-point numbers will be generated.
